100571.title: Handlebar component arrangement
guidance: Position 1 EA of Stem (Product Number SM-9087) at the center of 1 EA of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981) in an assumed assembly jig. The attachment detail is unspecified; see illustration 100571.

Demonstrate wrapping 40 IN total of purchased ML Grip Tape (Product Number GT-1209) around the grip regions, then position 2 EA of Road End Caps (Product Number EC-R098), one at each tube end. The tape allocation and cap fit are assumed.
